Enumerate()

Enumerates the geometry data for all tiles in the collection.

public IEnumerable<TileId> Enumerate()

Returns

IEnumerable<TileId>

An System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1 of System.Tuple`2 objects, where each tuple consists of a ChargerAstronomyShared.Contracts.Models.TileId representing the tile identifier and a ChargerAstronomyShared.Domain.Geometry.TileGeometry representing the associated geometry data.

Remarks

This method returns a sequence of tuples, where each tuple contains a tile identifier and its associated geometry data. The enumeration is deferred, meaning the tiles are retrieved lazily as the sequence is iterated.
